metadata.name: h8_roll_adjusted_futures_tsmom_v1
metadata.description: H8: Roll-Adjusted Futures TSMOM. Detects futures roll dates via calendar (last BD of roll months for ES/NQ/ZB quarterly, CL/GC monthly) validated by volume spikes and overnight gaps. Computes roll carry = open/prev_close - 1 on roll dates. Builds roll-adjusted returns R' = R + w*roll_carry. Grid over w in {0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}; selection by Val-only Sharpe. Base signal: vol_scaled_tsmom_signals (long_only, lookback=252, skip=1). Gates on pooled Val+Test OOS per PROMPT_V2. Includes base TSMOM ablation.
